issues.says: Error** in AIP (Andreatta–Iovita–Pilloni), Hilbert adic paper, author final version at Lemma 8.1, §8.1, printed p. 34: the proof applies level rigidity to α/ᾱ without showing that this quotient fixes the level marking; it should be supplemented by a proved freeness hypothesis: in the ℚ(√3), N = 7 CM example the quotient is −1, which moves the marking; affects the proof. (found in: 1005-N5.md)

Error** in Manning–Shotton, arXiv:1907.06043v2 at the proof of Theorem 6.8 (strong approximation and norm fibres): the source quotients by F× although reduced norms from a totally definite quaternion algebra are totally positive; it should be the narrow quotient by F₊×; F = ℚ(√3), with class number 1 and narrow class number 2, shows the difference; affects the proof. (found in: 1005-N1.md)

Error** in Barnet-Lamb–Gee–Geraghty–Taylor (BLGGT), arXiv:1010.2561 at p. 32 (l. 1388) and p. 34: the source gives the polarizing multiplier the sign µ_v(−1) = (−1)^n and calls ε^{1−n}r(χ) odd by definition; it should be (−1)^{n+w}, as BLGGT's own §A.2 formula (p. 87) gives; the CM character of weight (1,0) is a witness; affects a stated result. (found in: 1006-fable.md)

(found in: 1017-N1.md; 1017-N2.md)

Error** in Varshavsky, the later Varshavsky paper checked by the reviews (title not given) at a locator the reviews do not give: the source states a normal-cone fixed-locus (fixed-point) assertion more generally than it holds; it should be as the witness in the cited review requires; affects a stated result. (found in: 1040-N1.md; 1040-N2.md)

Gap** in Khare–Wintenberger (KW09) at Lemma 7.2(i), case q_v ≡ −1: the printed proof deduces γ_v from the residual representation alone; it should be as the witness in the cited review requires; affects the proof. (found in: 1005-fable.md)

Gap** in Balakrishnan–Dogra–Müller–Tuitman–Vonk, Explicit Chabauty–Kim for the split Cartan modular curve of level 13, Ann. of Math. 189 (2019) at Lemma 2.4 and its proof, p. 900: the printed lemma states its converse direction without a qualification it needs; it should be as the witness in the cited review requires; affects a stated result. (found in: 1021-scratch-locators.md)

issues.says: Misprint** in Besser–de Jeu (the syntomic-regulator paper cited as BDJ) at the tensor presentations of de Jeu's complexes, printed pp.884–886, including the quotient display after Lemma 3.19: the source says the last terms have the displayed tensor and exterior-power forms with no restriction; it should require residue field with more than two elements, as Lemma 3.19 does (fails for Z_(2), n=2); affects a stated result. (found in: 1043-N1.md; 1043-N3.md)

Misprint** in Silliman, Group Ring Valued Hilbert Modular Forms at Theorem 8.10 (level-one Hasse lift): the source says suitable lifts exist for all sufficiently large weights; it should require weights that are multiples of (p−1)p^{N₀}, N₀ depending on the precision, as Dasgupta–Kakde Theorem 8.8 states (p=5, precision 2, weight ≡4 mod 20 is excluded); affects a stated result. (found in: 1306-R5.md)

Misprint** in Kakde, The main conjecture of Iwasawa theory for totally real fields, arXiv:1008.0142v3 at §3 (character decompositions of Λ(G) and its K-groups): the source says the components are indexed by all absolute irreducible characters, which overcounts conjugate characters (e.g. Z₅[C₃]); it should index by Galois-orbit representatives, as the paper's own §5.1 does; affects the proof. (found in: 1307-N5.md)

issues.says: Error** in Česnavičius–Koshikawa, The A_inf-cohomology in the semistable case, arXiv:1710.06145v3 at Proposition 5.39, p.55: the source says the full augmentation ideal of a finite divided-power approximant has divided powers and is topologically nilpotent; it should use the extended chart ideal I·D^(m) (for p=m=2 on O_C, T=ξ²/2 has all powers nonzero mod 2); affects the proof. (found in: 1044-N1.md)

Error** in Bhatt–Morrow–Scholze, Integral p-adic Hodge theory (BMS1), arXiv:1602.03148v3 at the proof of Lemma 4.8, pp.35–36: the source says every rank-one O_F-submodule is principal, maximal ideal times principal, or the whole field; it should allow unrealized cuts such as {v > √2}, handled by choosing x outside mD so D = xO_F; affects the proof. (found in: 1044-N1.md)

Error** in Scholze, p-adic Hodge theory for rigid-analytic varieties (2013) at Definition 6.8 (structural de Rham period sheaf): the source says to complete O_X ⊗ A_inf[1/p] along ker θ directly; it should first p-adically complete the integral tensor product, then invert p and complete along ker θ, as Scholze's erratum item (3) states; affects a stated result. (found in: 1044-N2.md; 1044-N3.md; 1044-N6.md; 1062-N4.md; 1062-N5.md)

Error** in Berger, Représentations p-adiques et équations différentielles at §1.1 and Proposition 1.4 (radius dictionary for overconvergent rings): the source needed the coefficient-field correction recorded in the author's errata §1; it should be as the witness in the cited review requires (the radius uses the field-of-norms ramification index, not the absolute one, e.g. K=Q₃(μ₃)); affects a stated result. (found in: 1062-N1.md)

Error** in Caraiani–Newton, On the modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields, arXiv:2301.10509v3 at Lemma 5.6.5, printed pp.85–86: the source says the trace identity forces reducibility on the determinant kernel, including the projective-A₄ case; it should exclude that case or argue differently (over F₇ a group with kernel Q₈ is a counterexample); affects the proof (used on p.87). (found in: 1048-N2.md)

Error** in Bhatt–Scholze, Prisms and prismatic cohomology, arXiv:1905.08229v4 at Lemma 16.10(2), p.110: the source says the uncompleted quotient P/J equals the q-PD envelope quotient E/K; it should use the derived p-completion, i.e. the completed extended ideal as in Construction 16.13 (a square-zero counterexample shows IP need not be closed); affects a stated result. (found in: 1065-N1.md; 1065-N2.md)

Error** in Skinner–Wiles, Residually reducible representations and modular forms (1999) at Proposition 3.23, printed p.55: the source says T(ℓ)⊗[n] and S(ℓ)⊗[n] map by rules that force two different images of 1⊗[n]; it should send S(ℓ)⊗[n] ↦ S(ℓ)Θ(Frob_ℓ)⁻¹Φ(n), defining the map factor by factor; affects a stated result. (found in: 1066-N1.md)

Error** in Skinner–Wiles, Residually reducible representations and modular forms (1999) at printed p.76: the source says an auxiliary cyclic field of sufficiently divisible degree, inert at every prime other than p, can be chosen; it should impose only local conditions, since no cyclic degree-8 extension of Q has 2 inert (Grunwald–Wang); affects the proof. (found in: 1066-N1.md)

Error** in Kisin, The Fontaine–Mazur conjecture for GL₂ at the generic-rank, multiplicity and graded-piece statements corrected in Gee–Kisin, arXiv:1208.3179v5, Appendix B: the source's versions of these statements needed correction; it should be generic rank 2^|R|, the reciprocal multiplicity factor, support on the weight ring, and an extra local exclusion; affects a stated result. (found in: 1071-N1.md; 1071-N2.md)

Error** in Koshikawa–Yao, arXiv:2306.00364v1 at the essential-image criterion for p-Kummer local systems (test spaces of Definition 7.12): the source's criterion needed the authors' corrigendum (Lemma 1(2)); it should test on saturated log diamonds with strictly totally disconnected underlying space and p-divisible characteristic, since all-divisible test spaces miss tame inertia; affects a stated result. (found in: 1080-N1.md; 1080-N2.md)

Comp.) at Lemma 8.3, printed p.1040: the source says T^{1/4}|I₁(T,7/4)−κ₇| ≤ 0.302 on an interval starting at T=1; it should exclude an initial interval, since I₁(1)=0 while κ₇≈0.40765 (p.1038); affects a stated result. Error** in the source cited as "Lerch III" (Lerch zeta function, part III) at Theorem 3.4: the source says a vanishing formula for the covering and monodromy contributions in too broad a form; it should retain the exceptional zero-index branch contribution; affects a stated result. Error** in Lipnowski–Tsimerman, arXiv:1511.02212 at §5 (concentration estimate): the source's growth-constant normalization needed correction and the argument misses the real-Weil surface with Weil polynomial (x²−p)²; it should be as the witness in the cited review requires (corrected normalization; separate quaternionic hypothesis for that surface); affects the proof.
